_comment: Routing scenarios for scripts/agent/routing_check.py. 'delegate': true forces a delegation prompt, so the check measures which agent is chosen; false sends the task as written and expects the main session to keep it (no project subagent). 'agents' lists the accepted first Agent call; 'skills' lists skills that are acceptable when the main session keeps the task.

scenarios.prompt: Add a new public method ApiClient.withTimeout(Duration) to TestFly's ApiClient and keep binary compatibility for consumers.
Write a TestNG test class for the REST endpoints GET /users and POST /users with TestFly's ApiClient, including negative cases.
Turn the existing UsersApiTest into a Cucumber BDD feature with step definitions and a runner.
The login button locator in our LoginPage page object no longer matches on https://www.saucedemo.com. Find the right locator and fix it.
Create an iOS native test scenario for the login screen of our sample app with TestFly's mobile module.
Discover the selectors of the Settings screen on the running Android emulator and give me the @MobileFind page-object fields.
The mobile device session is not closed when a Cucumber @mobile scenario fails in CucumberHooks. Fix this bridge lifecycle bug in io.testfly.mobile.
Create a k6 stress test for the /users endpoint of our API.
The CI job 'Unit Tests' fails intermittently with a report file not found error. Find the root cause.
Before I commit, review my diff against the last release tag for public API breaking changes.
I changed the default of a configuration key in the SDK. Update the English and Turkish documentation.
Research whether jsoup 1.18 works on Java 21 and what its license allows before we add it as a dependency.
There is a bug in the framework's retry handling. Work test-first: write the failing test that reproduces it, then we fix it.

Bug report: with retry.maxAttempts=3 the SDK retries a failing step only once before reporting failure. Turn this bug report into one failing regression test for the SDK's retry handling. No TDD cycle, just the reproduction.
Check whether the project is ready for a Maven release.
Using the knowledge graph, which components are affected if I change ApiClient?
Write a JUnit 5 test for the login flow of https://www.saucedemo.com with a Page Object.
Write a JUnit 5 API test for GET /products with TestFly's ApiClient.
Write a Cucumber scenario for the saucedemo checkout flow.
